label: There exists ONE SAME selected actual concrete necessary root n retaining the PerfectRootAt body…
paraphrase: There exists ONE SAME selected actual concrete necessary root n retaining the PerfectRootAt body (selected-root uniqueness, esse maximum and formal-or-eminent perfection), represented esse/essence identity, firstness, matter/form exclusion and remoteness. This SAME n satisfies the signature IsGod predicate through the explicit nominal interface, all exact nine case predicates, and the signature primitive HasClassicalAttributes field. The nine use IsSimple, IsPerfect, causal IsSupremelyGood, IsTheOneGod of the actual signature IsGod predicate, Infinite, IsImmutable (PureAct), Eternal, HasIntellect and HasWill. Unity is therefore not merely selected-root uniqueness. No uniqueness of all necessary individuals, all-world rootness, moral omniperfection, omniscience, free will or independently defended infinity/eternity/causal/cognitive applicability is asserted.
